root_idea.summary: The supplied evidence centers on producing a whistling sound, especially the call of a bird.
root_idea.development: The lexical discussion connects the bird's whistling with the Quranic description of a human ritual sound as bird-like and of little benefit; it also records a related bird-name formed from the same lexical complex.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested verbal noun meaning whistling; presented under its normalized lexical citation form.

senses.definition: Whistling; a bird-like whistling sound or performance.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, this is coordinated with تصدية and describes the sound treated by the unbelievers as their prayer at the Sacred House, characterized as having little devotional benefit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bird so called because of its colour.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct nominal bird-name, not the Quranic verbal noun مُكَاء.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Defines مُكَّاء as a bird named for its colour.

cautions: The Quranic verbal noun مُكَاء meaning whistling should be distinguished from the separately attested bird-name مُكَّاء.
